name: Exhibit with interpretation
reader_question: What are the key figures, and which row supports each interpretive point?
relationship: A compact figures table paired with numbered notes; each note cites a table row.

capacity.what: table rows (1 to 2 value columns, 2 to 4 notes)

use_when: The reader needs exact figures and a short, evidenced reading of them on one slide
Each interpretive point can be tied to a single row
avoid_when: The shape of the data matters more than exact values — use a chart family pattern
The interpretation spans many rows or needs argument — use the frame interpretation panel or a separate slide

data_contract.notes: Value column headings; separate statuses, not summed
ref must resolve to a table row; one note per row

units: One unit and one date basis for all rows; numbers right-aligned and formatted with the shared grammar.

not_data_bound: Note badges (numbered circles) are text shapes; they do not update if table rows are re-ordered

table_alternative: The table alone, with notes moved to the frame interpretation panel.
variations: Table plus a single native chart
Two-column figures with a delta column
limitations: Notes are limited to four and 130 characters each to stay beside the table
Numbered references are typed, not linked

excluded_alternatives.form: Callouts drawn with leader lines onto the table
excluded_alternatives.reason: Leader lines drift when rows reflow and add decoration without information
Breaks the claim-to-row traceability the pattern exists to show
